intro: こそ is a spotlight: it picks out X as the one that really counts, this one and no other. It is emphatic and usually positive: 今年こそ (this year for sure), これこそ (this is exactly it), こちらこそ (no, it is I who should thank you).

skills.rule: To say this very X, X and no other, put こそ after X in place of は, が or を.
skills.explain:
こそ singles out one item as the true or right one, often in contrast to what came before or what someone else said: 今度こそ勝つ (this time I will win, unlike before), これこそ探していた本だ (this is exactly the book I was looking for). In set replies it turns the compliment back: こちらこそよろしく (the pleasure is mine), 私こそすみません (no, I am the one who should apologise).

こそ replaces は, が and を; other particles stay in front: ここでこそ, あなたにこそ. It also attaches to から to make precisely because: 好きだからこそ厳しく言う. It does not attach to ので.

The edge: さえ marks a surprising extreme (often negative: can't even), こそ a chosen one (positive: this is the one). は is a neutral topic; だけ limits to only X. One more use to recognise: X こそ...が means X may be so, but: 値段こそ高いが、質はいい (it is expensive, granted, but the quality is good).
patterns: 今年 / 今度 / 明日 こそ [resolution]

examples.jp: こちら{こそ}、よろしくお願[ねが]いします。
examples.en: Likewise, I look forward to working with you.

examples.jp: 今年[ことし]{こそ}日本[にほん]に行[い]きたいです。
examples.en: This year I really want to go to Japan.

examples.jp: これ{こそ}私[わたし]が探[さが]していた本[ほん]です。
examples.en: This is exactly the book I was looking for.

examples.jp: 今度[こんど]{こそ}遅[おく]れないでくださいね。
examples.en: This time, please don't be late.

examples.jp: 大切[たいせつ]な友達[ともだち]だから{こそ}、本当[ほんとう]のことを言[い]うんです。
examples.en: It's precisely because you're a dear friend that I'm telling you the truth.

contrast.note: さえ is even: the surprising extreme, mostly with negatives (名前さえ書けない). こそ is the very one: the right choice, mostly positive (今年こそ合格する).
今年は行きたい just sets this year as the topic. 今年こそ行きたい adds: this year for real, unlike the years before.
だけ excludes everything else in a limiting way (only this). こそ selects this one as the one that matters, without saying the others are absent.

mistakes.bad: 今年[ことし]は{こそ}合格[ごうかく]したい。
mistakes.good: 今年[ことし]{こそ}合格[ごうかく]したい。
mistakes.note: こそ replaces は, が and を; it does not follow them.

mistakes.bad: 好[す]きなので{こそ}、厳[きび]しく言[い]います。
mistakes.good: 好[す]きだから{こそ}、厳[きび]しく言[い]います。
mistakes.note: Precisely because is always からこそ; ので cannot take こそ.

mistakes.bad: 疲[つか]れて名前[なまえ]{こそ}書[か]けなかった。
mistakes.good: 疲[つか]れて名前[なまえ]{さえ}書[か]けなかった。
mistakes.note: Couldn't even is the extreme case, which is さえ. こそ is not even.

skills.tip: Can you say this very one, this time for sure, or it is I who? Then こそ. If it is even, use さえ.
